### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
`ADD_ARG` supplies chainable setters and const or mutable getters.
No global default: each reader owns its fallback.
Order: code map; no independent measured convergence order.
No defining equation: this section maps control flow or data ownership.
:::

`ADD_ARG` supplies chainable setters and const or mutable getters. YAML readers build the module tree and selected
readers reject keys outside their fixed list. The root reader delegates layout, hydro, scalar, integration, output,
coordinates and boundaries.

### Derivation

No separate derivation: this section describes an interface or control-flow path. Numerical operators are derived in
their owning chapters.

### Numerical method

Validate at the reader that owns the key. `check_keys` ignores non-map nodes and otherwise reports the unknown key
together with valid keys and any delegated reader. The root options reader has no equivalent whole-document whitelist.
This is configuration validation, with no numerical stencil, stage or accuracy order.

@fig-ch01-options-flow shows the data or call sequence.

### Limits

The accepted `distribute.backend` spelling does not set the backend: the layout reads `BACKEND` instead. Programmatic
defaults and YAML defaults must be compared per reader; this chapter does not equate them. Numerical
environment-switch coverage is in @sec-ch12-matrix and the environment appendix.
